findings: All83exact-target rows assessed:16direct,2stableminor directions,44curricular,8illustrations,13outcomes. Each of18generators is owned once:15core,1eating-behaviour,1sustainable-food-systems,1animal-origin candidate. Support topics do not create extra alternatives.

Integer decision tokens identify normalized CSV positions22090–22172; the preserved sourceExcelpositions22058–22140 are a separate provenance field. Original numeric references are correct and retained; no registry change or false discovery-reference repair is made.

Direct product innovation, safer/healthier food, ingredient behaviour, packaging, processing, protein transition and quality interests receive an honest integrated partial response. Their full food-specific sequence remains a limitation, not a reason to invent a surrogate degree. The sustainable-food-system question is supported by explicit food-chain sustainability and programme learning outcomes.

The named eating-behaviour minor’s current neuroscience/sensory/consumer/behaviour-change substance supports the second concept. The food-system direction instead centres actual farming/ecology/resources and environmental governance, with curricular consequences rather than a new label on the same plan.

Animal-origin was assessed as its own candidate. SustainableFarming covers husbandry/aquaculture/alternative proteins and InfectionImmunity includes allergy; generic biology and welfare also contribute. These do not form the meat/milk/insect-product quality, processing and food-allergy sequence. A complete distinct programme would depend on borrowed general environmental or human-clinical content without enough animal-food substance. This is an individual feasibility/comparability judgment, not a degree-title rejection or blanket residual bucket.

The public page supports the stated product/R&D/quality/process/teaching/consultancy and conditional further-study outcomes. Example projects and careers are not guaranteed course assignments or professional qualifications, and they do not generate independent programmes. No unsupported discovery claim or relationship edit was needed.
